description: Source code implementing cryptographic hash functions, including algorithm selection, digest and HMAC operations, and factory functions for creating hash instances, primarily for SHA1 and SHA256.

classes.name: Implementation::HashType<OPERATION>
classes.description: Template class managing hash or HMAC operations, including initialization, data ingestion, and final calculation.

classes.name: Implementation::Operation::Digest
classes.description: Wrapper for digest update and finalization functions.

classes.name: Implementation::Operation::HMAC
classes.description: Wrapper for HMAC update and finalization functions.

methods.name: Algorithm
methods.description: Selects hash algorithm parameters based on hash_type enum, supporting SHA1 and SHA256.

methods.name: hash_create
methods.description: Creates a hash object for a specified hash type.

methods.name: hash_create_hmac
methods.description: Creates an HMAC object using a vault, hash type, and secret ID.

methods.name: hash_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a hash or HMAC object.

methods.name: hash_ingest
methods.description: Feeds data into the hash/HMAC object for processing.

methods.name: hash_calculate
methods.description: Calculates the final digest or HMAC value.
